- **Bounded auto-recovery** — `gsd_repair` runs "},{"id":"p13s10","text":"up to 2 rounds of plan(gaps) → execute(gaps-only) → verify(gaps) for a phase whose verification foun"},{"id":"p13s11","text":"d gaps, stopping with clear causes on anything it cannot recover from.
- **Autonomous path** — `gsd_"},{"id":"p13s12","text":"autonomous` drives all remaining incomplete phases of the active milestone end-to-end (auto-deriving"},{"id":"p13s13","text":" CONTEXT when absent) and reports a per-phase STATUS; it stops on a hard failure, never ships, and n"},{"id":"p13s14","text":"ever runs milestone lifecycle.

- The **GitHub CLI (`gh`)** installed "},{"id":"p15s4","text":"and authenticated if you want `gsd_ship` to create pull requests."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### What "replace the default agent loop plugin" means"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The mechanical turn machine in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop` (tool scheduling, context assembly, ses"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"sion preparation) **stays** — that is DeepSeek Harness's core runtime, and a session cannot run with"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"out it. The bundle replaces the agent loop's *behaviour*:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- `cordis.patch.yml` overrides the host `agent-loop` row's `config` (last-write-wins per row), repla"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"cing `agents: []` with a configured **`gsd`** agent.
- `gsd-persona` installs opengsd's phase-loop m"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"ental model as the system-prompt section every session reads (order -100, before the deployment pers"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"ona) and a runtime-context contribution that orients every model step at the current `STATE.md` posi"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"tion.
- The `gsd_*` phase tools are the loop steps."}],"truncated":true}
